run_hotpotqa_preprocessing: run the HotpotQA dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_hotpotqa_dataset_instance: create a HotpotQA dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace hotpot_qa distractor split
extract_supporting_context: extract supporting fact context sentences from a HotpotQA datapoint using the get_context method
map_dataset_to_qa_pairs: map a HuggingFace HotpotQA dataset split to a list of question-context and answer tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the HotpotQA dataset with a given seed
